description.narrative: Forestry is one of the main concerns of the newly elected Government of Bulgaria and is emerging as a priority in the new CPS (under preparation). Proper management of forestry resources is especially important because of the implications for improved governance and financial managementcomma climate changecomma possibilitiescomma protection of environmental resources and provision of sustainable rural employment. Potential EU grant funding is limited and only available for private forest ownerscomma while almost 90% of the forests in Bulgaria are state owned and EU grant funding is not available for the institutional reform in the sector. The reform has been declared a matter of urgency and priority by the new Government as Bulgarian forests have been severely damaged by mismanagement and by the inadequate institutional set up. The issue of good governance and related institutional strengthening is central to the sustainable management of forests and to providing for their public goods function. Bulgaria is GAC country and the Bank is by far the only and the best positioned institution given previous engagement in the sector to assist with good governance in forestry. The Development Objective of the proposed IDF financing is to support Bulgaria develop cost effective and sustainable Forest Institutions that will manage the state owned forest and supervise the whole forest sector regardless of ownership in an environmentallycomma economically and socially sound and equitable manner. The grant to be executed by the Executive Forest Agency will support the follwoing activities: (i) Developing a common vision and awareness raisingcomma covering stakeholder participationcomma monitoring and evaluation of the refor process and the performance of the sector; (ii) Technical support for the institutional reform processcomma including: review of proposed chnages in the forest law; learning from examples of institutional models in the region; economic and financial analysis of different institutional reform proposals; and analysis of the state timber marketing systems; and(iii) Capacity building and trainingcomma including study tourscomma and training of key forest staff to manage/support the new forest institituons in the country. TF096228 The development objective is to provide stand alone technical support to the Bulgarian Executive Forestry Agency to help finalize the ongoing institutional re-organization and train key staff to enhance management of the country's forestscomma and improve service delivery (e.g.comma timber and non-timber product marketing; fuelwood and non timber forest products for communities; and extensioncomma conservation and environmental services).
